WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(state_county_province, '') AS state_group,
         COUNT(*) AS account_base
  FROM Customers
  GROUP BY COALESCE(state_county_province, '')
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_group,
         account_base,
         1.0 * account_base / SUM(account_base) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(ss.account_base) AS combined_account_base,
       AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ss.share - a.avg_share) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM state_shares ss
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE ss.share > a.avg_share;
